arxiv-1702-05615.title: Wigner functions for angle and orbital angular momentum: Operators and dynamics
arxiv-1702-05615.creator: H. A. Kastrup
arxiv-1702-05615.description: Abstract Recently a paper on the contruction of consistent Wigner functions for cylindrical phase spaces 𝕊 1 × ℝ \mathbb{S}^{1}\times\mathbb{R} , i.e. for the canonical pair angle and orbital angular momentum, was presented, main properties of those functions derived, discussed and their usefulness illustrated by examples.

arxiv-2109-12149.title: Airfoil’s Aerodynamic Coefficients Prediction using Artificial Neural Network
arxiv-2109-12149.creator: Hassan Moin, Hafiz Zeeshan Iqbal Khan, Surrayya Mobeen and Jamshed Riaz
arxiv-2109-12149.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Hassan Moin, Hafiz Zeeshan Iqbal Khan, Surrayya Mobeen and Jamshed Riaz. Figuring out the right airfoil is a crucial step in the preliminary stage of any aerial vehicle design, as its shape directly affects the overall aerodynamic characteristics of the aircraft or rotorcraft. Besides being a measure of performance, the aerodynamic coefficients are used to design additional subsystems such as a flight control system, or predict complex dynamic phenomena such as aeroelastic instability.

arxiv-2301-12774.title: The slow viscous flow around doubly-periodic arrays of infinite slender cylinders
arxiv-2301-12774.creator: Lyndon Koens, Rohan Vernekar, Timm Krüger, Maciej Lisicki, David W. Inglis
arxiv-2301-12774.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Lyndon Koens, Rohan Vernekar, Timm Krüger, Maciej Lisicki, David W. Inglis. The slow viscous flow through a doubly-periodic array of cylinders does not have an analytical solution. However, as a reduced model for the flow within fibrous porous media, this solution is important for many real-world systems. We asymptotically determine the flow around a doubly-periodic array of infinite slender cylinders, by placing doubly-periodic two-dimensional singularity solutions within the cylinder and expanding the no-slip condition on the cylinder’s surface in powers of the cylinder radius.

arxiv-2303-06254.title: rate-distortion optimization with alternative references for UGC video compression
arxiv-2303-06254.creator: Xin Xiong, Eduardo Pavez, Antonio Ortega, Balu Adsumilli
arxiv-2303-06254.description: Abstract User generated content (UGC) refers to videos that are uploaded by users and shared over the Internet. UGC may have low quality due to noise and previous compression. When re-encoding UGC for streaming or downloading, a traditional video coding pipeline will perform rate-distortion (RD) optimization to choose coding parameters.

arxiv-2309-12932.title: Different Regular Black Holes: Geodesic Structures of Test Particles
arxiv-2309-12932.creator: Zihan Xi 1, Chen Wu 2, Wenjun Guo 1,
arxiv-2309-12932.description: Abstract This paper investigates the metric of previously proposed regular black holes, calculates their effective potentials, and plots the curves of the effective potentials. By determining the conserved quantities, the dynamical equations for particles and photons near the black hole are derived.

arxiv-2404-02795.title: Robust Pushing: Exploiting Quasi-static Belief Dynamics and Contact-informed Optimization
arxiv-2404-02795.creator: Julius Jankowski \affilnum 1, 2, Lara Brudermüller \affilnum 3, Nick Hawes \affilnum 3 and Sylvain Calinon \affilnum 1, 2
arxiv-2404-02795.description: Abstract Non-prehensile manipulation such as pushing is typically subject to uncertain, non-smooth dynamics. However, modeling the uncertainty of the dynamics typically results in intractable belief dynamics, making data-efficient planning under uncertainty difficult. This article focuses on the problem of efficiently generating robust open-loop pushing plans. First, we investigate how the belief over object configurations propagates through quasi-static contact dynamics.

arxiv-2507-19968.title: Dimer-Enhanced Optimization: A First-Order Approach to Escaping Saddle Points in Neural Network Training
arxiv-2507-19968.creator: Yue Hu, Zanxia Cao, Yingchao Liu
arxiv-2507-19968.description: Abstract First-order optimization methods, such as SGD and Adam, are widely used for training large-scale deep neural networks due to their computational efficiency and robust performance. However, relying solely on gradient information, these methods often struggle to navigate complex loss landscapes featuring flat regions, plateaus, and saddle points.

arxiv-2602-23912.title: Block-weighted random graphs: planar and beyond
arxiv-2602-23912.creator: Mihyun Kang, Zéphyr Salvy, Ronen Wdowinski
arxiv-2602-23912.description: Abstract We investigate random connected graphs from a block-stable class whose distribution is weighted based on the number of 2 2 -connected components, or blocks. This includes the class of planar graphs. For this, we develop a notion of a decorated block tree.

pmc-10613412.creator: Xuan Wang, Lei Xu, Xinglu Hu, Hongmou Zhao, Jichao Yin

pmc-11348641.creator: Bryan Felix, Fawaz Aldoohan, Hansanee U Kadirage, Sethulakshmi Keelathara Sajeev, Maryam Kayani, Mohamed Abdelsalam Ibrahim Hag Saeed, Sruthi Vempatapu, Khadija Nasim, Harini Pendem, Annia P Armenta, Zahra Nazir
pmc-11348641.description: Non-ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (NSTEMI) is associated with significant morbidity and mortality, occurring when the heart’s need for oxygen cannot be met. It is defined by elevated cardiac biomarkers without ST-segment elevation and often carries a poorer prognosis than most ST-segment elevation events. NSTEMI usually results from severe coronary artery narrowing, transient occlusion, or microembolization of thrombus/atheromatous material.

pmc-13219813.creator: Xiaoqian Lan, Hongyan Zhuang, Pengfei Li
pmc-13219813.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). uslaw-usc-t16-s430g7.title: 16 U.S.C. § 430g–7 — Conservation within Gettysburg Battlefield historic district
uslaw-usc-t16-s430g7.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s430g7.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 1 (National Parks, Military Parks, Monuments, And Seashores); Subchapter LX (National Military Parks). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Encouragement of conservation The Secretary shall take appropriate action to encourage conservation of the historic district by landowners, local governments, organizations, and businesses. (b) Prioritization of grants Within the historic district, the Secretary shall give priority.

uslaw-usc-t43-s492.title: 43 U.S.C. § 492 — Operation and maintenance charges generally
uslaw-usc-t43-s492.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t43-s492.description: United States Code, Title 43 (Public Lands); Chapter 12 (Reclamation And Irrigation Of Lands By Federal Government); Subchapter XI (Maintenance And Operation Of Works Generally). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In addition to the construction charge, every water-right applicant, entryman, or landowner under or upon a reclamation project shall also pay, whenever water service is available for the irrigation of his land.

uslaw-usc-t44-s2118.title: 44 U.S.C. § 2118 — Records of Congress
uslaw-usc-t44-s2118.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t44-s2118.description: United States Code, Title 44 (Public Printing And Documents); Chapter 21 (National Archives And Records Administration). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of the Senate and the Clerk of the House of Representatives, acting jointly, shall obtain at the close of each Congress all the noncurrent records of the Congress and of each congressional committee and transfer them to the National.
